title: readiness.json: the overnight readiness page (contract 1.17.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.17.0. Written by `harness readiness --site <dir>` beside readiness.html on the reports site: one row per calendar night (UTC) for the last ten nights, newest first, from the Main to RC forecasts kept on the `main-preview` branch and Main to RC's workflow runs (github.json). Derived from Readiness in src/readiness/model.ts. The band is deliberately absent: while the review floor caps the score the row carries the Gate only. Advisory: never read by a verdict, the Gate or an exit code. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

harness.description: The harness version that built the page.

github.description: What was read of the workflow history, or why it was not. For people: do not parse.

state.description: judged: a forecast was kept that night. unchanged: Main to RC finished green and kept nothing (the pair was already judged); `since` names the forecast it repeats. not judged: it ran and failed or was cancelled. running: a run has not finished. not yet: tonight, before any run. did not run: no run that night. not known: nothing kept and the workflow history was not read.

forecasts.description: The forecasts kept that night, newest first; empty unless judged.

since.description: On an unchanged night: the newest forecast kept before it, whose verdict it repeats.

runs.description: Main to RC's workflow runs that night, newest first; empty when there were none or the history was not read.

baselineMoved.description: Production moved between this row and the row below it: the delta starts again.

note.description: One sentence for the row. For people: do not parse.

commit.description: The commit side b's images were built from, when they all agree; the one to branch a release from.

digests.description: Side b's image digests, by app.

gate.description: confidence.json's Gate, or the verdict in capitals for a forecast kept before the score.

delta.description: The index entry's delta (reports-index.schema.json); null for a forecast kept before 1.16.1.

report.description: The kept report.html, relative to the site.
